تعتمدون (form VIII)
# تَعْتَمِدُونَ (taʕtamidūna) /taʕ.ta.mi.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# تُعْتَمَدُونَ (tuʕtamadūna) /tuʕ.ta.ma.duː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
